items.description: The canonical description of MLOps levels and practices.

lessons.title: What Is MLOps?
lessons.description: The discipline of operationalizing machine learning: people, pipelines, and platforms.

lessons.title: The ML Lifecycle
lessons.description: From problem definition to retirement: every stage a model passes through.

lessons.title: Reproducibility & Versioning
lessons.description: Version code, data and models together — the foundation of trustworthy ML.

lessons.title: Data Pipelines
lessons.description: Reliable, repeatable data flow: ingestion, validation, cleaning and feature preparation.

lessons.title: Feature Stores
lessons.description: One source of truth for features: consistent online and offline features.

lessons.title: Experiment Tracking
lessons.description: Log every run: metrics, hyperparameters and artifacts with MLflow.

lessons.title: Model Registry
lessons.description: Stage models through lifecycles and keep production versions audit-ready.

lessons.title: Training at Scale
lessons.description: Move from notebooks to managed training jobs with reproducible configs.

lessons.title: Model Packaging & Serialization
lessons.description: Wrap models into portable artifacts: pickle, ONNX, and MLflow models.

lessons.title: Model Serving APIs
lessons.description: Expose models over HTTP with FastAPI and MLflow serving — with proper request validation.

lessons.title: Containerization with Docker
lessons.description: Package the model, code and dependencies into one portable image.

lessons.title: Kubernetes Basics for ML
lessons.description: Orchestrate containers: pods, deployments, services and autoscaling.

lessons.title: Model Deployment Strategies
lessons.description: Ship models safely: shadow, canary and blue-green deployments with rollbacks.

lessons.title: Monitoring & Drift Detection
lessons.description: Watch predictions and features: data drift, concept drift and model performance decay.

lessons.title: Evaluation in Production
lessons.description: Estimate quality without labels: sampling, human review, and proxy metrics.

lessons.title: CI/CD for Machine Learning
lessons.description: Automate testing, training and deployment in pipelines that run on every change.

lessons.title: Testing ML Systems
lessons.description: Test data, features, models and infrastructure — because ML code is only part of the system.

lessons.title: Data & Model Governance
lessons.description: Auditability, access control and compliance for ML assets.

lessons.title: Cost & Performance Optimization
lessons.description: Balance accuracy against inference cost, latency and carbon.

lessons.title: LLMOps
lessons.description: Operationalize generative AI: prompt management, evals, guardrails and LLM monitoring.

lessons.title: MLOps Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course into a plan: build a production ML system and keep improving it.
